Get started

Panta API

Build Permissionless Prediction Markets Using Our Native API — quote, construct unsigned Solana transactions, and attribute trades without holding user keys.

Panta is a binary YES/NO prediction market infrastructure on Solana. This API lets your app browse markets, create markets, buy primary shares, read positions, build win and creator-fee claim transactions, and report trades. You never custody wallets. Panta returns unsigned transactions (or instruction lists). The user’s wallet signs. You broadcast on your RPC, then tell Panta the signature.
Trailing slashes are required. Authenticate with X-Api-Key or Authorization: Bearer <access> (Authentication).

​
Base URL

https://live-api.panta.market/api/v1
API reference pages include an interactive Try it playground against this host — see Authentication.

​
What you can do

Sign up and mint a key

Register or log in, create a pk_test_… / pk_live_… key, then call product routes.

Browse markets

List the USDC catalog, fetch detail prices, and read market or wallet trades.

Create a market

Quote the USDC creation fee, build an unsigned tx, register after broadcast.

Primary buy

Quote a YES/NO fill on the bonding curve, build instructions, submit the signature.

Positions

List a wallet’s USDC holdings, phase, and claim eligibility.

Claim winnings

Build unsigned claim instructions when a resolved market is claimable.

Claim creator fees

Build unsigned instructions to withdraw graduated-market creator fees.

Trade attribution

Verify on-chain buys and win claims for volume reporting.

​
Custody model

Panta cooks the transaction. The user signs. You file it on-chain. Then you send the receipt.

​
Amounts

SurfaceFormat
Create marketUSDC base units as integer strings (6 decimals), e.g. "50000000" = 50 USDC
Primary buyHuman-readable decimal strings, e.g. "20.00"
